source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references. Crossref independently confirmed exact records for Instant Replay, multiprocessor VM replay, PRES, ODR, DoublePlay, and Lamport event ordering. The official USENIX ReVirt record, primary rr paper archive, current Microsoft Coyote replay documentation, and official rr GitHub project resolved directly. The initially cited rr-project.org host did not resolve during review and was replaced before completion with the directly resolving official project repository. Sources support the scoped distinctions among faithful, synchronization, output-equivalent, probabilistic, VM, and user-space replay; claims are paraphrased and no inaccessible quotation is used.

evidence: Definitions and Notation consistently defines checkpoint, ordered trace, deterministic transition, context, observation equivalence, happens-before, compatibility manifest, landmarks, and first divergence.
Faithful state/history equality remains distinct from equality under an output projection O and from probabilistic search success.

evidence: Recomputed the four-event lost-update trace: both reads observe zero, each private value is zero, and both writes publish one, so recorded and replayed final state is one.
At choice 2 after A:R and B:R, both A:W and B:W are enabled; the corrupted expected singleton A:W therefore diverges exactly there.
artifacts/snippets/CONPAR-070/report.json records four choices, matched replay, final one, exact choice-2 expected/actual diagnostic, empty stderr, and zero exit code.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The finite arithmetic validates the teaching state machine and context check only. It does not implement threads, syscalls, signals, weak memory, checkpoints, compression, or secure logging.

evidence: Replay induction was rechecked from compatible checkpoint through unique event resolution, recorded injection, and deterministic transition; any missing premise yields divergence rather than continued equality.
Synchronization replay requires all cross-thread conflicts to be mediated by reproduced synchronization under the same memory model; one unsynchronized conflict invalidates this premise.
Output equivalence proves equality only under O and therefore cannot justify unrecorded internal causality.

evidence: The replay induction explicitly includes compatible initial state, deterministic semantics, complete nondeterminism capture, unique event/context resolution, and immediate divergence on premise failure.
